projects.title: Evento
projects.description: A full-stack event management platform designed to simplify event planning, service booking and event organization. Integrates highly tactile UI layouts with interactive responsive web workflows.
projects.problem: Event booking and planning often suffer from disconnected operational vectors and disjointed schedules between clients, vendors, and organisers.
projects.solution: Built a cohesive system focusing on UI/UX Design, frontend responsive layouts, dynamic planning boards, and structured API integration to manage booking calendars in a single space.
projects.challenges: Synchronizing parallel vendor schedules with user booking carts gracefully on the React frontend.
projects.learnings: Deepened my skills in layout design, state structures, and creating high-performance interactive scheduling elements in React.

projects.title: Hopin
projects.description: Travel management application focused on structured trip planning and cohesive itinerary travel organization. Engineered using pure object-oriented methodology.
projects.problem: Keeping track of multi-leg trajectories, bookings, and coordinate updates across dynamic travels usually requires juggling messy files and loose sheets.
projects.solution: Programmed a structured travel manager in Java. Modeled travel events and route calculations with Object Oriented Programming (OOP) architectures for high code modularity and stability.
projects.challenges: Modeling complex recursive routes and leg structures with clean class hierarchies and standard design patterns.
projects.learnings: Gained a deep, expert understanding of OOP paradigms in Java, data collections, inheritance, polymorphism, and algorithmic modularity.
